# NSPanel HAUI 0.5.7

0.5.7 makes the link to the display eight times faster and cuts the integration download to about a fifth.

## Display link at 921600

Both TFTs now boot the Nextion at 921600 bps instead of 115200, and the firmware starts its UART at the same rate. The display version advances to **0.4.6**.

A panel still running the 0.4.5 TFT answers at 115200. Its first boot after the firmware update waits for the display, power-cycles it and probes the Nextion rates until 115200 answers; that boot takes up to about 20 seconds longer than usual. The display update that follows switches the TFT to 921600, and the first boot after that can take as long again while the firmware finds the new rate. Both boots finish on their own; later boots are immediate, because the firmware remembers the rate. If the panel is still on **Waiting for Initialization** after a minute, power-cycle it once.

The hub installs the 0.4.6 TFT only after the 0.5.7 firmware is running, because the firmware reports the display version it requires. That order is deliberate: an older firmware could not follow the display to 921600. There is still one TFT per display model and nothing to choose.

## Smaller download

GitHub builds the source archive — the zip a HACS or Marketplace install downloads — from the repository, and `nextion/` carried ~59 MB of display sources and compiled TFTs that no install reads. That directory is now marked `export-ignore`, so an install or update downloads about 16 MB instead of about 74 MB. Clones, raw TFT URLs and release assets are unchanged.

## Before updating

Nothing. No renamed entity, no changed service, no migration. Update the integration first, then the firmware; the display follows. Expect the two slower first boots described above.
